name: forge
description: The `forge` marketplace. Ships one plugin, also called `forge`: 64 command-invoked toolkits spanning WordPress engineering, design and accessibility, writing, DevOps and data, cloud and architecture, security, code cleanup, codebase analysis, and documentation and diagrams. Nothing auto-triggers - every tool runs only when its slash command is typed.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Sixty-four command-invoked toolkits in one plugin, sorted into ten categories: WordPress, design and frontend, writing and content, DevOps and data, cloud and architecture, security, code cleanup, code, docs and diagrams, and utilities. Nothing auto-triggers - every toolkit is reached by an explicit slash command, and each command loads its own procedure file on invocation. Run /forge for a category-then-item picker, or call any command directly.
